evals.prompt: What does it cost to run one inference of this model, in money and carbon?
evals.expected_output: Builds a cost model with a named canonical unit, estimates energy and carbon via Green Algorithms, marks every value with an honesty status, validates, and renders a report.

evals.prompt: Give me a professional PDF report of the running cost of this repo.
evals.expected_output: Produces the cost model and Markdown report, then compiles a DOCX and PDF with md2star using the reference template; states what is measured versus estimated.

evals.prompt: Estimate the energy footprint of one CLI run on my machine.
evals.expected_output: Selects the CLI-invocation canonical unit, prefers a measured runtime, and honestly labels the derived energy as estimated when power is not measured.

evals.prompt: Break down my AWS bill by service for last month.
evals.expected_output: Does not trigger. This is a cloud-billing dashboard question, not a per-unit cost-of-running model.

evals.prompt: Attach a profiler to my running service and find the hot functions.
evals.expected_output: Does not trigger. This is live-service observability and profiling, not a cost-of-running model.
